discs.name: Wine Warm, Lamps Alight
discs.desc:
Midnight bells chime to welcome the Springseek Festival
as fireworks set the night sky ablaze.
Amid the revelry, the crowd wishes
that there is joy and peace for the days and years ahead.

skills.name: Wine Warm, Lamps Alight
skills.desc: Increases the Ultimate DMG of Terra Trekkers in the squad by &Param1&. When a Versatile Terra Trekker deals Skill DMG, increases the effect by an additional &Param2& for &Param3&s.

skills.name: Eternal Pulse
skills.desc: Increases Terra Versatile Trekkers' ATK by &Param1&. Increases the main Terra Trekker's Auto Attack DMG by &Param2&.

skills.name: Bright Refrain
skills.desc: After the main Terra Trekker deals DMG &Param1& times, increases own ATK by &Param2& for &Param3&s.

discs.name: The Bud of Change
discs.desc:
Beneath the soil steeped in conspiracy and intrigue,
Watchful, calculating gazes interweave.
Something is struggling to break through the earth.

skills.name: The Bud of Change
skills.desc: Increases DMG of Umbra Trekkers' Minions by &Param1&. When the main Umbra Trekker summons a Minion, increases the Minion's DMG by &Param2& for &Param3&s.

skills.name: Shadow Mastermind
skills.desc: When any Umbra Trekker triggers a Mark that inflicts Dark Burn, increases their minions' Minion DMG by &Param1& for &Param2&s.

skills.name: Growing Ambition
skills.desc: Increases the Skill DMG dealt to targets inflicted with Dark Burn by the main Umbra Trekker by &Param1&. Increases the Minion DMG dealt to targets inflicted with Dark Burn by the main Umbra Trekker's minions by &Param2&.

discs.name: Veiled Dawn of Spring
discs.desc:
The drawn curtains create a cozy, warm retreat.
Her smile is tender,
but the syringe in her hand glints chillingly.
"Don't be afraid. It will be over before you know it."

skills.name: Veiled Dawn of Spring
skills.desc: Increases Skill DMG of Support Terra Trekkers by &Param1&. When a Versatile Terra Trekker deals Skill DMG, inflicts Spring Blossom on the target: increases Terra Skill DMG taken by &Param2& for &Param3&s.

skills.name: The Sovereign Elixir
skills.desc: Increases Terra Versatile Trekkers' Skill Crit DMG by &Param1&. Increases the main Terra Trekker's Skill DMG to targets inflicted with Spring Blossom by &Param2&.

skills.name: Blossom's Requiring
skills.desc: After the main Terra Trekker deals DMG to targets inflicted with Spring Blossom &Param1& times, increases Terra squadmates' Skill DMG by &Param2& for &Param3&s.

discs.name: Petals of Blooming Mirage
discs.desc: A fierce wind sends petals swirling through the sky as paper umbrellas snap shut Look—within the sea of blossoms, before the formation of parasols A slender figure dances gracefullyIs it real… or just a fleeting dream?

skills.name: Petals of Blooming Mirage
skills.desc: Increases the squad's Umbra DMG by &Param1&. When an Umbra Versatile Trekker deals Skill DMG, inflicts 1 stack of Dark Sakura on the target for &Param2&s, stacking up to &Param3& times. Dark Sakura: At max stacks, increases Umbra Skill DMG Taken by &Param4&.

skills.name: Fading Petals
skills.desc: Increases Umbra Versatile Trekkers' Crit DMG by &Param1&. Dark Sakura gains an additional effect: Each stack increases the Umbra Ultimate DMG Taken by the target by &Param2&.

skills.name: Lunar Mirage
skills.desc: When an Umbra Versatile Trekker deals Ultimate DMG to a target with max stacks of Dark Sakura, the Main Umbra Trekker gains Flower Feast for &Param1&s. When the Main Umbra Trekker with Flower Feast triggers a mark that inflicts Dark Burn, increases own Skill Crit Rate by &Param2& for &Param3&s. When the Main Umbra Trekker with Flower Feast triggers a mark to activate the effects of Dark Shackles, increases own Auto Attack Crit DMG by &Param4& for &Param5&s.

discs.name: Dawn After Winter
discs.desc: Think of it as nothing more than a marvelous Stella Drama.When we return our present, our trusted friends are still here with us.Leave the dark Monolith behind. The winter night will pass.And look: spring's warm sunlight will shine once more upon this city that once thrived.

skills.name: Dawn After Winter
skills.desc: When the Ventus Main Trekker deals Ultimate DMG, they gain 1 stack of Bitter Cold: increases Auto Attack and Skill DMG by &Param1& for &Param2&s, stacking up to &Param3& times.

skills.name: Weightless Tread
skills.desc: Increases the Ultimate DMG of the main Ventus Trekker by &Param1&. Bitter Cold gains an additional effect: Each stack increases own ATK by &Param2&.

skills.name: Silent Descent
skills.desc: Bitter Cold gains an additional effect: Each stack increases own Ventus DMG by &Param1&.

discs.name: Delivered by the Breeze
discs.desc: Sharpen the crease, press firm the wax,Longing turns to ink upon the page.A sudden gust sweeps the words away,Leaving a thousand thoughts ... lighter than the air.

skills.name: Delivered by the Breeze
skills.desc: When an Aqua Versatile Trekker deals Skill DMG, the Aqua Main Trekker gains 1 stack of Thought Ripple for &Param1&s, stacking up to &Param2& times. At &Param3& stacks, increases the Aqua DMG dealt by all friendly units by &Param4&. At &Param5& stacks, increases the Skill DMG dealt by Aqua Trekkers in the squad by an additional &Param6&.

skills.name: Words into Longing
skills.desc: Increases the ATK of Aqua Trekkers in the squad by &Param1&. Thought Ripple gains an additional effect: Each stack increases own Auto Attack DMG by &Param2&.

skills.name: Words of Endless Devotion
skills.desc: Thought Ripple gains an additional effect: Each stack increases own Ultimate DMG by &Param1&.

discs.name: Snowy Night Surprise
discs.desc:
The winter wind carries prayers from afarThe messenger arrives with blessings and gifts
Stepping into view as the midnight bells ringThis Snowish Festival gift is for you, who never lost your childish wonder

skills.name: Snowy Night Surprise
skills.desc: Increases Ignis DMG of the squad by &Param1&. When any Ignis Trekker deals Skill DMG, inflicts Ode, lasting &Param2&s. Ode can be converted into Hymn. Hymn: Increase Ignis DMG Taken by &Param3& for &Param4&s, stacking up to &Param5& times.

skills.name: Kingdom of Fries
skills.desc: Hymn grants extra effects: Increases the Ignis Skill DMG Taken by &Param1&. When Ode is converted to Hymn, increases the Skill DMG of Ignis Trekkers in the squad by &Param2& for &Param3&s, stacking up to &Param4& times.

skills.name: Crispy Crunch
skills.desc: Ode grants extra effects: Reduces enemy ATK by &Param1&. Ignis Trekkers in the squad deal increased Ultimate DMG to targets inflicted with Ode by &Param2&.

discs.name: Traces of Starlight
discs.desc: Dispel the haze and race toward the stars beyond; Ring the bell of beginnings and set our adventure in motion. Love and hope await along the way—and for this journey… thank you for being here.

skills.name: Traces of Starlight
skills.desc: When the main Trekker's HP drops below 10%, instantly gains a shield equal to &Param1& of Max HP for &Param2&s. This effect can only be triggered once every &Param3&s.

skills.name: Starlight Journey
skills.desc: Increases the squad's ATK by &Param1&.

skills.name: Memory Resonance
skills.desc: Increases the squad's Elemental DMG by &Param1&.

discs.name: Phantom of the Banquet
discs.desc: Countless toasts exchanged, endless lofty talks—visions and dreams only seem real in this fleeting moment.Yet beyond the light, on the moon's hidden side,shadows long for a world where dreams can truly exist.

skills.name: Phantom of the Banquet
skills.desc: Increases the squad's Umbra DMG by &Param1&. When an Umbra Versatile Trekker deals Skill DMG, the Umbra Main Trekker gains 1 stack of Blossom Glow for &Param2&s, stacking up to &Param3& times. At max stacks, increases the Skill DMG dealt by Umbra Trekkers in the squad by &Param4&.

skills.name: Umbral Harmony
skills.desc: Increases Umbra Versatile Trekkers' Ultimate DMG by &Param1&. Blossom Glow gains an additional effect: Each stack increases own Skill DMG and Ultimate DMG by &Param2&.

skills.name: A Toast Behind the Scenes
skills.desc: When the Main Umbra Trekker with max stacks of Blossom Glow triggers a mark that activates the effects of Dark Burn, increases own Skill DMG by &Param1& for &Param2&s. When the Main Umbra Trekker with max stacks of Blossom Glow triggers a mark that inflicts Dark Shackles, increases own Auto Attack DMG by &Param3& for &Param4&s.

discs.name: Stellar Destination
discs.desc: As flowers and water embrace the earth, as stars revolve in search of one another,all things in this world lean on each other—so let me share your solitude as well.In the dark depths of space, let me light the starlight that guides you home.

skills.name: Stellar Destination
skills.desc: Lux Versatile Trekkers gain 1 stack of Sync Rate per second on the battlefield: Each stack increases their Lux DMG by &Param1& for &Param2&s, stacking up to &Param3& times. When Sync Rate is at max stacks, dealing DMG additionally inflicts Hostile Reaction on the target: Increases the Lux Auto ATK DMG the target takes by &Param4& for &Param5&s.

skills.name: Start Conversation
skills.desc: Increases the squad's Lux DMG by &Param1&. Sync Rate gains an additional effect: Each stack increases own Crit DMG by &Param2&.

skills.name: Mutual Understanding
skills.desc: When the Lux Main Trekker triggers a mark on a target with Hostile Reaction and inflicts Thunderbolt, increases own Ultimate Crit DMG by &Param1& for &Param2&s. When the Lux Main Trekker triggers a mark on a target with Hostile Reaction and inflicts Lucent, increases own Skill Crit DMG by &Param3& for &Param4&s.

discs.name: Touch of Miracle
discs.desc: Gears lock into place, sparking a universe of wild imagination.The rabbit unrolls her inspiration list while tweezers and wrenches cobble together absurd inventions.The girl's pen skips across the blueprints.And beneath an adorable shell, a dangerous new weapon comes to life.

skills.name: Touch of Miracle
skills.desc: When a Terra Vanguard Trekker casts a skill, they gain Assembly for &Param1&s, stacking up to 2 times. When a Terra Vanguard Trekker has 1 stack of Assembly, increases their Skill DMG by &Param2&. When a Terra Vanguard Trekker has 2 stacks of Assembly, increases their ATK by &Param3&.

skills.name: Sky of Fantasy
skills.desc: Increases the squad's Terra DMG by &Param1&. Each stack of Assembly gains an additional effect: increases own Skill DMG by &Param2&.

skills.name: Construction Blueprint
skills.desc: Assembly can stack up to 3 times. When a Terra Vanguard Trekker has 3 stacks of Assembly, increases own Ultimate DMG by &Param1&.

discs.name: Joyful Gathering
discs.desc: Whether after a nerve-wracking, narrow escape from death,or a candid, grudge‑shattering conversation,there is always a joyful, open‑hearted gathering, where people share a meal together, finally letting go of the past.Looking at everything around her, she suddenly realizes this very moment is what is most worth cherishing.

skills.name: Joyful Gathering
skills.desc: When the Ignis Main Trekker casts a skill, increases own Skill DMG by &Param1& for 12s and grants 1 stack of Dark Blessing for 12s, stacking up to 3 times. When the Ignis Main Trekker deals Skill DMG, 1/2/3 stacks of Dark Blessing grant a shield equal to &Param2&/&Param3&/&Param4& of Base Max HP for 20s to self. This effect can be triggered once every 30s.

skills.name: Meowth's Triumph
skills.desc: Each stack of Dark Blessing additionally increases own Skill DMG by &Param1&.

skills.name: Dark Ceremony
skills.desc: Increases the ATK of Ignis Trekkers in the squad by &Param1&. When Dark Blessing is at max stacks, increases own Ultimate DMG by &Param2&.

discs.name: Little Paradise
discs.desc: A little paradise that's ours alone,running with her through the dim lamplight.Don't be afraid of stumbling—I'll hold your hand tight,until we make it to the end together.

skills.name: Little Paradise
skills.desc: After a Terra Vanguard Trekker casts a skill, they gain Loaded for &Param1&s, stacking up to 2 times. When a Terra Vanguard Trekker has 1 stack of Loaded, dealing Skill DMG inflicts the following effects on the target: increases Terra Skill DMG Taken by &Param2& for &Param3&s. When a Terra Vanguard Trekker has 2 stacks of Loaded, increases their Skill DMG by &Param4&.

skills.name: Clockwork Waltz
skills.desc: Increases the squad's Terra DMG by &Param1&. Each stack of Loaded gains an additional effect: increases own Skill Crit DMG by &Param2&.

skills.name: Symphony Box
skills.desc: Loaded can stack up to 3 times. When a Terra Vanguard Trekker has 3 stacks of Loaded, increases own ATK by &Param1&

discs.name: Fleeting Glimmers
discs.desc:
Sunlight filters through the clear water,
warming the ocean with a gentle glow.
A girl gazes up at the shimmering light—
what lies beyond those ripples?

skills.name: Fleeting Glimmers
skills.desc: Increases the squad's Aqua DMG by &Param1&. When an Aqua Support Trekker casts a skill or for every 5s they are on the field, grants Tide Weave to the squad for &Param2&s, stacking up to &Param3& times. When a Trekker with Tide Weave inflicts Aqua Mark to a target, it additionally increases this target's Aqua Skill DMG Taken by &Param4& for &Param5&s.

skills.name: Azure Echo
skills.desc: Increases the Crit DMG of Aqua Trekkers by &Param1&. When any Trekker with Tide Weave triggers an Aqua Mark, the target takes &Param2& increased Aqua Auto Attack DMG for &Param3&s.

skills.name: Sun-Kissed Sands
skills.desc: Tide Weave gains an additional effect: Each stack increases own Aqua DMG by &Param1&, and increases the ATK of Aqua Support Trekkers by an additional &Param2& per stack. After an Aqua Support Trekker casts their Ultimate, each stack of Tide Weave they possess restores Energy equal to &Param3& of their Max Energy, up to &Param4&.

discs.name: Dappled Sunlight
discs.desc:
Broken patterns of light drift across her hair,
as she steps into a flowing stream.
The forest wind follows the sound of insects,
whispering that midsummer has quietly arrived.

skills.name: Dappled Sunlight
skills.desc: When an Aqua Support Trekker casts a Skill, or every 5s they are on the field, they grant 1 stack of Ripple Echo to the entire squad: Increases Aqua DMG by &Param1& for &Param2&s, stacking up to &Param3& times. When a Trekker granted Ripple Echo triggers Aqua Mark, increases this Trekker's ATK by &Param4& for &Param5&s.

skills.name: Summer Time Whispers
skills.desc: Increases the Ultimate DMG of Aqua Trekkers in the squad by &Param1&. Ripple Echo gains an additional effect: Each stack increases own Aqua DMG dealt by &Param2&.

skills.name: Summer Isle Song
skills.desc: When Ripple Echo is at max stacks, increases own Aqua Skill DMG by an additional &Param1&.
